notes: Proteus Maximus is a 950W IP65 LED framing/profile moving-light fixture (automated lighting), not a traditional AV switching/display device — none of the required category/type enum values fit well, so "other"/"Other" were used. Data pulled verbatim from Elation's official datasheet (also mirrored at https://www.elationlighting.com/products/proteus-maximus): "5pin XLR DMX In/Out", "IP65 RJ45 ethernet In/Out", "IP65 Locking Power Cable In". The power inlet connector's exact part/model is not named in the datasheet (only described generically as an "IP65 Locking Power Cable"); powercon was chosen as the closest listed id since Neutrik powerCON-style IP65 locking connectors are standard on this class of outdoor fixture, but this is an inference, not a confirmed part number. No power-out/link port is documented (unlike some other Elation fixtures that daisy-chain power). Ethernet and DMX are each physically in/out pairs for daisy-chaining multiple fixtures; no Ethernet speed (10/100/1000) is published. Device is not rack-mountable (yoke-mounted moving-light fixture), so rackUnits was omitted. Weight 117 lbs (53 kg); AC 120-240V 50/60Hz, max 1,400W consumption. Supports DMX, RDM, Art-Net, sACN control protocols.
